subject.title: feat: AI safety event taxonomy — OTEL and Prometheus exporter mappings

question: Should OpenClaw adopt this six-event AI-safety taxonomy and manifest-authorized plugin emission model as a permanent core diagnostics and plugin-SDK contract?
rationale: The choice defines operator-facing safety semantics, a plugin authorization boundary, public SDK types, and long-lived telemetry names; code review cannot safely establish that product and security policy without owner intent.

options.title: Approve the bounded taxonomy
options.body: Approve the six-event contract and trust model, then require the exporter defects, clean stacking, compatibility tests, and live telemetry proof before merge.

options.title: Keep emission core-trusted
options.body: Accept exporter support only for core-owned events and defer any plugin-facing safety-event contract until a narrower security design is approved.

options.title: Pause the series
options.body: Close or pause the stacked series until maintainers define a different canonical taxonomy and ownership model.

recommendation.title: Approve the bounded taxonomy
recommendation.body: Approve the six-event contract and trust model, then require the exporter defects, clean stacking, compatibility tests, and live telemetry proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision spans core diagnostics, plugin SDK compatibility, and the safety-event authorization boundary.
